jobs.title: Forecasting Expert
jobs.jd:
About the opportunity:

As a Forecasting Analyst in the WFM team, you are responsible for producing high quality demand forecasts for different workstreams across operations. Your forecasts will be used for capacity planning, budget planning, and shift scheduling of our in-house teams and external partners. Additionally your forecasting expertise will be used to support the implementation of new products and key initiatives, and you will be the internal go-to person for forecasting related questions. You will challenge existing frameworks and implement innovative solutions using your experience and knowledge.

 

In this role, you will:

  • Forecast resource requirements across different teams and workstreams to meet customer/stakeholder demand and required service levels.

  • Produce analytics on forecast performance, as well as volume evolution and the effect of internal or external factors on volume such as new product launches.

  • Assist in the further development of forecasting methodologies, models and tools in order to increase forecast accuracy and efficiency.

  • Partner with Growth, Membership, and Product Teams to understand the key drivers of volume and incorporate them into the forecasting and planning process.

  • Provide consultative support for the leadership team, guiding and advising to develop effective productivity measures, performance management intelligence and resource planning effectiveness.

  • Collaborate with a broad range of analytics teams at N26 to utilise shared platforms, insights and innovations.

  • Maintain an accurate events log detailing what is included in the forecast and reasons for variance to forecast.

 

What you need to be successful:

  • 2+ years of experience working in demand forecasting, resource planning, or directly related field

  • Advanced level of ability in applied mathematics, statistics, scenario modelling, demand modelling and analysis

  • Expert with Excel or Google Sheets, and ability with SQL, Python, or R is a huge plus

  • Experience with business analytics platforms such as Google Looker, Metabase, or similar systems

  • Graduated with a degree in Statistics, Mathematics, or other related field of study/relevant level of professional experience


 

Traits:

  • Actively help yourself (and others) be successful.

  • Continuously learn and challenge the status quo.

  • Think globally, act locally.

  • Strong bias for action.

  • Give and receive open, direct and timely feedback.

jobs.title: Agentic AI Senior Consultant
jobs.jd: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Agentic AI Senior Consultant based in Switzerland. In this role, you will act as a trusted technical advisor and hands-on engineering expert, helping enterprise customers design, implement, and scale advanced agentic AI solutions. You will lead the entire customer delivery lifecycle, from identifying high-value business opportunities and designing multi-agent architectures to deploying production-ready systems. Combining strong software engineering expertise, applied AI knowledge, and event-driven architecture experience, you will transform AI concepts into secure, scalable, and reliable enterprise applications. You will work closely with customer engineering teams, business stakeholders, and internal product specialists to accelerate the adoption of intelligent automation. Your responsibilities will also include establishing best practices for agent development, evaluation, monitoring, and governance while mentoring other technical professionals. This is an opportunity to work at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation within an international, customer-focused, and technically ambitious environment. Accountabilities: Own the technical success of enterprise customers' agentic AI initiatives, managing the complete delivery lifecycle from initial discovery and solution design through development, production deployment, ongoing operations, and advisory services. Lead customer workshops to identify, assess, and prioritize high-value agentic AI use cases, translating business objectives into measurable and technically achievable workflows. Design and implement sophisticated multi-agent architectures, including agent decomposition, orchestration, task delegation, tool integration, memory management, state handling, and human-in-the-loop controls. Develop, review, and troubleshoot production-quality software using Go or Python, building agents, plugins, tools, and integrations that meet enterprise requirements. Deploy and operate agentic AI applications using Docker, Kubernetes, and major cloud platforms, ensuring scalability, reliability, and maintainability. Integrate AI agents with enterprise applications, data sources, and legacy systems through MCP servers, A2A protocols, REST APIs, and event-driven messaging architectures. Implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, knowledge bases, embeddings, and real-time event context strategies to improve agent accuracy and access to relevant information. Apply the Agent Development Lifecycle (ADLC) throughout solution delivery, covering requirements gathering, architecture design, evaluation pipelines, testing, version control, release management, monitoring, and operational documentation. Establish robust observability, security controls, governance frameworks, and responsible AI practices for agentic systems, including tracing, quality evaluation, cost and latency monitoring, access control, and auditability. Advise customers on large language model selection and optimization across providers such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, AWS Bedrock, and Azure AI Foundry, considering prompt engineering, token consumption, costs, and model performance trade-offs. Act as a long-term technical advisor, identifying opportunities for further AI adoption and helping customers progress from isolated pilots to enterprise-wide, event-driven AI implementations. Conduct recurring technical reviews, solution health checks, and roadmap discussions aligned with customer priorities and annual planning cycles. Enable customer engineering teams to independently operate, maintain, and extend implemented solutions through technical workshops, collaborative development sessions, and comprehensive documentation. Develop reusable technical assets, including reference architectures, implementation patterns, accelerators, and best practices, to improve delivery efficiency and consistency across future engagements. Represent customer needs and technical feedback to internal Product and Engineering teams, contributing insights that influence product development and roadmap priorities. Collaborate closely with agentic AI platform engineering teams to resolve complex customer challenges, validate new capabilities, and contribute reusable agents, plugins, and accelerators. Provide technical leadership and mentorship to other professionals, helping strengthen agentic AI expertise and delivery capabilities across the Professional Services organization. Communicate complex technical concepts, AI-related risks, and architectural trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Travel when required to support customer engagements, including occasional international travel. Requirements: At least 7 years of professional experience in professional services, technology consulting, systems integration, forward-deployed engineering, or enterprise application development. Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and deploying LLM-based applications and agentic AI solutions, including at least one solution successfully taken into production. Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices, including version control, automated testing, CI/CD, and release management, with practical experience applying a structured Agent Development Lifecycle (ADLC). Strong programming proficiency in Go or Python, with Go considered a significant advantage. Practical experience designing and implementing multi-agent systems, including task delegation, orchestration, coordination, and autonomous decision-making. Familiarity with agent development frameworks such as Google ADK, LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or comparable technologies. Experience with agent interoperability and tool integration, including Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocols, and designing APIs for agent-based appl

This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on. Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production. Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes. Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months. Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before. Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop. Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship. You're Our Person If... You have 3+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you’d be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field You are fluent in English + Dutch or German You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have. jobs.title: AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning)
jobs.jd: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning) based in Switzerland. As an AI Research Engineer specializing in Agentic Reinforcement Learning, you will drive research and innovation in next-generation intelligent systems. You will develop advanced reinforcement learning techniques that improve decision-making, adaptive behavior, and performance across multimodal AI architectures. Working with text, images, audio, and other data modalities, you will help build models capable of solving complex, real-world challenges. Your work will involve designing scalable training infrastructure, optimizing reward mechanisms, and improving the reliability of autonomous AI agents. You will explore cutting-edge approaches involving diffusion-based generative models, autoregressive architectures, and unified multimodal frameworks. Through rigorous experimentation and benchmarking, you will push the boundaries of model performance, efficiency, and generalization. This fully remote opportunity offers the chance to contribute to impactful AI research within a fast-moving, globally distributed technology environment. Accountabilities In this role, you will conduct advanced research and develop scalable reinforcement learning systems for multimodal AI applications. Your main responsibilities will include: Research and develop reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, including diffusion-based approaches for image generation, autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, and unified architectures integrating multiple modalities. Design and implement scalable reinforcement learning infrastructure supporting distributed training across complex multimodal systems. Develop and optimize reward modeling strategies to improve training stability, align model behavior with desired outcomes, and prevent reward hacking and related failure modes. Create, curate, and maintain multimodal simulation environments and training datasets to support robust model development, evaluation, and benchmarking. Design and implement rigorous evaluation protocols to measure model performance, monitor progress against established baselines, and validate research improvements. Analyze and optimize policy performance across different modalities by identifying bottlenecks in training, credit assignment, reward optimization, and cross-modal alignment. Investigate emerging reinforcement learning paradigms that enable AI agents to learn more effectively from environmental feedback. Improve model exploration, decision-making, and adaptive behavior to achieve state-of-the-art performance in dynamic, real-world environments. Conduct large-scale experiments and translate empirical findings into practical algorithmic improvements. Publish and present research findings at leading international conferences, including ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, and ECCV. Requirements The ideal candidate combines strong theoretical knowledge of reinforcement learning with hands-on experience developing and optimizing large-scale multimodal AI systems. The following qualifications and technical skills are expected: Master's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline. A PhD in Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, or a closely related field is preferred. Strong track record of AI research, including publications in leading international conferences. Demonstrated experience conducting large-scale reinforcement learning experiments in multimodal and vision-centric systems, including online reinforcement learning environments. Proven ability to improve domain-specific decision-making and achieve measurable gains in policy performance. Deep understanding of reinforcement learning algorithms and optimization techniques applied to vision and multimodal learning. Strong knowledge of policy stability, exploration strategies, sample efficiency, and optimization in complex, high-dimensional environments involving images, video, and other modalities. Advanced proficiency in PyTorch and modern deep learning frameworks for computer vision and multimodal AI. Hands-on experience building end-to-end reinforcement learning pipelines covering simulation, model training, evaluation, and production deployment. Ability to address fundamental reinforcement learning challenges, including sample inefficiency, exploration-exploitation trade-offs, and training instability. Experience designing robust evaluation frameworks and using empirical research to continuously improve algorithmic performance. Established research publication record at top-tier conferences such as ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, or ECCV. Strong analytical thinking, scientific problem-solving skills, and the ability to translate advanced research into practical AI solutions. Benefits Fully Remote Work: Work remotely from anywhere in the world, with a globally distributed team. International Collaboration: Collaborate with talented researchers, engineers, and technology professionals across different countries and disciplines. Cutting-Edge AI Research: Work on advanced reinforcement learning, multimodal architectures, generative AI, and next-generation intelligent systems. Research and Innovation: Explore new methodologies and contribute to state-of-the-art developments in artificial intelligence. Scientific Recognition: Opportunities to publish research and present findings at leading international AI and machine learning conferences. Professional Growth: Develop expertise in emerging AI technologies while contributing to challenging, high-impact research initiatives. Global Technology Environment: Be part of an ambitious, fast-growing organization working across AI, digital finance, peer-to-peer technology, and other innovative fields. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Ops
jobs.jd: About Cantina: Cantina Labs is a social AI company, developing a suite of advanced real-time models that push the boundaries of expression, personality, and realism. We bring characters to life, transforming how people tell stories, connect, and create. We build and power ecosystems. Cantina, our flagship social AI platform, is just the beginning. If you're excited about the potential AI has to shape human creativity and social interactions, join us in building the future! About the Role: We are looking for an ML Engineer to own the production inference stack for our text-to-speech (TTS) and speech recognition (ASR) models, end to end. Our research team delivers trained model checkpoints; you will productionize them as low-latency, real-time streaming services that run cost-efficiently on GPUs. The role covers the inference engines, the Kubernetes infrastructure they run on, and the performance benchmarking and accuracy validation that let us ship changes safely. You will bridge research and production, and own latency, throughput, cost and accuracy as we scale. What You’ll Do: Build and optimize streaming inference engines for TTS and ASR models, including multi-stage model pipelines. Optimize latency (time to first chunk, p50/p99) and throughput using continuous batching, CUDA Graphs, torch.compile and mixed precision. Maintain numerical parity with the reference implementation through automated accuracy regression tests, per stage and end to end. Deploy and operate GPU inference services on Kubernetes: autoscaling, containerization and infrastructure as code. Build CI/CD for model artifacts, with model versioning and reproducible releases. Own observability and performance benchmarking: p50/p99 latency, real-time factor (RTF), GPU utilization and cost per request. Partner with research to productionize new models. What You’ll Bring: Hands-on experience deploying, scaling and optimizing ML models in production, beyond consuming model APIs. Working knowledge of the full inference stack, from CUDA kernels to serving frameworks, with depth in some layers; expertise across all of them is not expected. GPU performance optimization: profiling (Nsight Systems, PyTorch Profiler), memory bandwidth, CPU-GPU synchronization. Solid understanding of model serving: continuous batching, KV cache management, request scheduling. Production experience with Kubernetes, CI/CD and cloud infrastructure. Strong Python and PyTorch, and a rigorous approach to performance benchmarking. Experience with speech or audio models (TTS, ASR, voice conversion). Experience with inference frameworks such as vLLM (vLLM-Omni), SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, TensorRT or Triton Inference Server. Compensation: When determining compensation, a number of factors will be considered, including skills, experience, job scope, location, and competitive compensation market data. Benefits for U.S.-based roles: Competitive salary and generous company equity Medical, dental, and vision insurance – 99.99% of premiums covered by Cantina 42 days of paid time off, including: 15 PTO days 10 sick days 15 company holidays 2 floating holidays Generous parental leave & fertility support 401(k) retirement savings plan Lifestyle spending account – $500/month to use however you’d like Complimentary lunch and snacks for in-office employees One Medical membership, and more!

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer, AWS Applied AI Solutions
jobs.jd: AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset. We're building Chorus, a real-time document workspace where AI agents are actual collaborators: an agent gets a cursor in the doc, edits the same CRDT, and shows up in presence right next to you. We wrote it from scratch in Rust and TypeScript; we sync in under 50ms with hundreds of simultaneous editors on a single document, and it costs roughly a dollar per builder per year to run. It's an exciting combination of greenfield work with a massive user base that provides immediate feedback when something doesn't work. Requirements • You proactively seek out problems, propose solutions, and own delivery • You find ways to deliver code with agents at high speed without sacrificing the quality of the code or the software. • Experience in building distributed and high-concurrency systems We're a small team with an unusually direct line from idea to thousands of builders using it. If you want to be one of maybe a dozen people in the world shipping production CRDT infrastructure that treats AI as a peer, this is the job. Key job responsibilities • Own the front end of a real-time collaborative editing product end to end: its architecture, performance and reliability as it grows from early customers to broad AWS adoption • Take a front end that grew faster than its foundations and make it one the team can move quickly and safely in. Find the worst pain points, set a direction and drive the cleanup to completion • Design and deliver major features on a modern editor stack (React, TipTap/ProseMirror, Yjs CRDTs, Rust compiled to WASM), balancing short-term delivery with long-term health • Know when a one-off fix is the right call and when a repeated pattern needs a shared component, hook or abstraction. Raise it with the team and build it • Lead technical discussions with backend and partner teams on API contracts, real-time sync behavior and UX tradeoffs. Bring data, write down the options and help the team reach a decision • Raise the front-end bar through thorough code reviews and clear conventions for state management, testing and component design, and by onboarding newer engineers into the codebase • Make the front end observable and production-ready: client-side error and performance monitoring, alarms on what you ship, solid test coverage, and real ownership during on-call A day in the life Your mornings are usually free for focus work -- architecture deep dives and hard problems. Around 11 you'll have standup, then grab lunch with the team (if you like) before the afternoon opens up for design reviews, CR feedback, or unblocking an engineer. Some days you're deep in code; others you're on a call with a customer team working through how their system integrates with yours. You're the person who knows the system most deeply -- and you work to ensure you're never the bottleneck. The problems are hard and the stakes are high -- but we believe we can move fast, do exceptional work, and have a full life outside of it. About the team Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud. Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. - 4+ years of non-internship professional front end, web or mobile software development using JavaScript, HTML and CSS experience - 5+ years of front-end developer creating prototypes or wire-frames for enterprise web applications or workflows experience - Experience developing with MVC/MVM frameworks (e.g. React.JS, AngularJS, Vue) - Experience in web applications design and development - Knowledge of web services technologies such as SOAP, HTTP, WSDL, XSD, and REST - Experience in a broad range of software design approaches and common UX patterns. You will play a key role in developing a next-generation industrial operating system, taking innovative products from concept to production. The role combines agentic AI, multimodal machine learning, industrial data integration, and full-stack engineering. You will work with real-world data from sensors, machines, and operational systems to deliver intelligent solutions that improve efficiency, reliability, and decision-making. This is a high-ownership opportunity in a fast-moving, zero-to-one product environment. You will help establish the foundations of an ambitious platform designed to transform industrial operations. Develop and deploy agentic AI systems, including orchestration, tool use, state management, and human-in-the-loop workflows. Build agent runtimes and orchestration frameworks supporting specialized agents for vision quality, predictive maintenance, and operations planning. Design context assembly systems using industrial ontologies and memory, including tool dispatch, approval gates, tracing, and cost controls. Develop multimodal data pipelines combining video processing, computer vision, and structured operational data. Implement computer vision capabilities such as object detection, segmentation, and action recognition, using technologies such as YOLO and OpenCV. Process industrial sensor data, including RTSP video, time-series telemetry, vibration, thermal data, and PLC/OPC-UA streams. Develop memory systems for trace storage, playbooks, asset templates, and reusable failure-pattern libraries. Build operational interfaces such as dashboards, evidence-based alerting workflows, replanning tools, and audit trails. Develop integration connectors for ERP, CMMS, WMS, industrial historians, and PLC systems, ensuring data normalization and consistent schema mapping. Deliver end-to-end solutions spanning data ingestion, model serving, backend services, and frontend interfaces. Ensure production systems meet demanding requirements for reliability, latency, scalability, cost efficiency, and operational usability. At least 3 years of experience building and shipping production AI systems; 5+ years preferred. Proven experience developing agentic AI products and production systems, including orchestration, tool integration, state management, and human oversight. Experience as an early-stage engineer at a venture-backed startup, contributing to products and systems from zero to one. Strong background in AI and machine learning applied to physical-world systems. Experience working with large-scale industrial data, such as video streams, IoT devices, sensor telemetry, vibration, thermal data, or PLC/OPC-UA systems. Hands-on experience building multimodal AI pipelines that combine computer vision with structured operational data. Understanding of data ingestion, normalization, temporal alignment, data quality, and ground-truth challenges in real-world environments. Experience with industrial ontologies, knowledge graphs, or structured context systems based on asset hierarchies and operational processes. Experience integrating AI systems with enterprise and industrial platforms such as ERP, CMMS, WMS, historians, or PLC systems. Strong software engineering skills across backend and frontend development, including Python and TypeScript. Experience with production-oriented technologies such as FastAPI, PostgreSQL, React Native, and OpenCV. A practical understanding of system reliability, failure modes, latency, cost management, and human interaction. Ability to work autonomously, take ownership, and deliver in a fast-paced, high-intensity environment. Strong motivation to solve complex industrial challenges through hands-on engineering and applied AI. Exceptional employee equity package, with an equity pool described as twice the industry standard and an estimated value of more than $200,000 from day one. jobs.title: Sr. Applied Scientist, Applied AI & Data Architecture
jobs.jd: Application deadline: Nov 15, 2026 Do you want to define how enterprises customize their own models ? Do you enjoy work that spans data curation, post-training, evaluation, and production deployment of customized models? As a Senior Applied Scientist in Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will build that path from customization to trusted evaluation. You will prove it with customers on their own data. You will help customers decide when and how to customize foundation models, using techniques that range from parameter-efficient fine-tuning and distillation to preference optimization and reinforcement fine-tuning. You will turn that work into reusable recipes, evaluation methods, and open-source accelerators that let builders customize models reliably and cost-effectively. The role splits roughly 50/50 between direct customer engagements and building leverage through reusable science assets, open source, and thought leadership. - Customer work: You will partner with customer science and engineering teams on their hardest customization problems. You'll frame the problem, choose the right approach, design the evaluation, and work hands-on to get customized models into production. - Building time : You will develop reference implementations and training recipes, contribute to open-source projects, and publish findings that raise the bar for the broader community. You will work closely with AWS service teams to close the loop between what customers need and what AWS builds. You will be the team's scientific bar-raiser. You will set evaluation standards, review modeling choices, and publish what you learn, internally and externally. You will work closely with the service teams so that the patterns we prove in the field become native features. This is a global role within the Solutions Architect organization. You will maintain deep relationships with AI service and science teams and collaborate with specialists and builder customers across regions to stay current on the state of the art and influence roadmaps. Key job responsibilities - Own the evaluation methodology. Design the evaluation methodology behind every model-selection and customization decision. Score quality, cost, latency, and safety in a way that is reproducible, statistically sound, and calibrated to each customer's quality bar. - Lead customization engagements end to end. Drive work from data curation and synthetic data generation through fine-tuning, distillation, continued pre-training, and reinforcement learning. Re-score every change against the same harness so customers see exactly what they gained. - Invent where no textbook solution exists. Develop new techniques such as reward design for agentic tasks, simulation-based evaluation, and efficient serving of small decision models, then package them as reusable code any Solutions Architect can run. - Turn engagement learnings into reusable assets. Build reference architectures, open-source accelerators, workshops, enablement materials, blogs, and papers that form a repeatable path from evaluation through deployment. - Advise field teams and customers. Act as the scientific advisor on trade-offs among prompting, retrieval, customization, and frontier models, including knowing when not to customize. - Mentor and influence across teams. Mentor engineers and Solutions Architects in ML methodology. Turn customer evidence into feature requests and proposals for AWS service teams that make field-proven patterns native product capabilities. A day in the life You start the morning reviewing a customer's distillation results, where a smaller model is closing the gap with a much larger one. The gains cluster in one task slice, so you flag possible data leakage before the design review. Afterward, you add a held-out evaluation set and a capability-regression check to the training recipe. In the afternoon, you share engagement findings with a product team to shape how evaluation fits into the customization workflow. You wrap up by refining an open-source evaluation harness you'll release alongside a customer workshop. About the team Applied AI and Data Architects (AIDA) is a team of specialized AI prototypers with a product mindset. The team builds a portfolio of domain-specific Tech Field Products in areas such as semantics, data engineering, ML, AI security/governance/agent-ops, and DevOps. Model customization and evaluation is one of the team's focus areas. Its goal is to make foundation and open weight model customization repeatable, measurable, and accessible to builders. Each product is grounded in customer reality. The team earns the right to guide by building alongside customers. - PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience - Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language - 4+ years of building machine learning models for business application experience - Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc. - Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc. - Experience customizing models for agentic use cases, such as tool use, multi-step reasoning, or reinforcement learning from environment or verifier feedback - Experience with model efficiency techniques such as quantization, distillation, and inference cost and latency optimization Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Senior AI Research Engineer - LLM Training & Inference Infrastructure
jobs.jd:
As a Research Engineer on the Frontier Foundations team, you will partner with Research Scientists to build the systems that run large-scale LLM training, reinforcement learning, and inference at Datadog. You will build and operate an in-house distributed runtime that schedules work across large GPU clusters, and you will own how quickly researchers can iterate and how reliably long training runs complete. 

Building on our track record of AI-powered solutions (e.g., Bits AI, Bits Evolve, and our time series foundation model Toto), Datadog AI Research (DAIR) tackles high-risk, high-reward problems grounded in real-world challenges in cloud observability and security. 

The Frontier Foundations team builds and maintains the high-performance infrastructure that lets us train and serve large language models at scale. It supports both of our research areas: 

Trained Agents for Observability -- Post-training models to operate autonomously across Datadog's domain. SRE incident response is our first target, with a clear path to code repair, security response, and infrastructure optimization. We build the simulation environments, RL training loops, and evaluation infrastructure needed to train agents that match or surpass frontier models at a fraction of the cost. 

 

What You'll Do: 

  • Design, build, and operate distributed training and inference infrastructure for large language models, including Mixture-of-Experts models 
  • Scale training with parallelism strategies (data, tensor, pipeline, and expert), memory optimization, checkpointing, and failure recovery
  • Build inference and rollout systems that support evaluation, experimentation, and RL without slowing down training
  • Build execution environments and sandboxes for online RL and agent post-training
  • Own continuous performance validation: regular benchmarks of rollout speed, training throughput, and learning behavior, with dashboards that make regressions visible 
  • Improve the researcher experience: job submission, scheduling, quotas, GPU utilization, and observability
  • Work with platform teams on cluster capacity, networking, and scheduling across GPU providers 
  • Investigate performance and reliability problems across hardware, software, and distributed systems

jobs.title: Senior AI Research Engineer - GPU Systems & Kernels
jobs.jd:
As a Research Engineer on the Frontier Foundations team, you will partner with Research Scientists to make large-scale model training and inference as fast and efficient as the hardware allows. You will work at the lowest level of our stack, writing and tuning GPU kernels and removing the memory and communication bottlenecks that limit large Mixture-of-Experts models on the latest GPUs.

Building on our track record of AI-powered solutions (e.g., Bits AI, Bits Evolve, and our time series foundation model Toto), Datadog AI Research (DAIR) tackles high-risk, high-reward problems grounded in real-world challenges in cloud observability and security.

Frontier Foundations builds and maintains the high-performance infrastructure that lets us train and serve large language models at scale. It supports both of our research areas:

Trained Agents for Observability - Post-training models to operate autonomously across Datadog's domain. SRE incident response is our first target, with a clear path to code repair, security response, and infrastructure optimization. We build the simulation environments, RL training loops, and evaluation infrastructure needed to train agents that match or surpass frontier models at a fraction of the cost.

What You'll Do:

  • Write, tune, and debug GPU kernels (CUDA, Triton, or similar) for the operations that dominate LLM training and inference.
  • Optimize for the latest NVIDIA GPU generations, including memory hierarchy, tensor cores, and low-precision formats such as FP8 and FP4
  • Reduce communication cost in distributed workloads (all-to-all, all-reduce) and overlap communication with compute across NVLink and across nodes
  • Profile end-to-end training and rollout workloads to identify whether they are compute-, memory-, or communication-bound, and quantify the headroom
  • Build benchmarks, profiling tools, and regression tests that guide optimization decisions
  • Collaborate with Research Scientists to turn new model architectures into efficient implementations
  • Explore emerging techniques such as low-precision training and serving, speculative decoding, and fused or persistent kernels

Who You Are:

  • You have depth in at least one of: GPU kernel development and optimization (CUDA or similar), low-latency communication and collective operations (e.g., RDMA, NCCL), or large-scale training infrastructure
  • You can reason about hardware constraints (memory, bandwidth, interconnect topology) and explain where a bottleneck is and how you would confirm it
  • You are proficient in a systems language (e.g., C++, Rust, or CUDA C) and in Python
  • You have strong debugging and profiling skills, including tools such as Nsight
  • You can explain design and performance trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

Bonus Points (any of the following):

  • You have experience with Mixture-of-Experts models, expert parallelism, or sparse model inference
  • You are familiar with GPU communication libraries such as NCCL or NVSHMEM, and with compute/communication overlap
  • You have experience with Triton, CUTLASS, or similar kernel frameworks
  • You are familiar with distributed training frameworks such as Megatron-LM, TorchTitan, or DeepSpeed
  • You have built GPU-intensive systems in graphics, rendering, simulation, or scientific computing
  • You have contributed to open-source ML or systems infrastructure projects

jobs.jd: Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video subscriptions such as Apple TV+, HBO Max, Peacock, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads. Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience. As a Prime Video team member, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people. We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you! Key job responsibilities The science challenges include: - Heterogeneous customer responses. The same customer responds differently to ads depending on what they’re watching, how engaged they are, and their broader streaming context. We need to understand and predict this variation to make better advertising decisions in real time. - Signal sparsity in streaming. Unlike search or retail advertising, streaming offers no clicks, no conversions, and limited direct feedback. We must develop creative approaches to infer customer preferences, intent, and tolerance from indirect behavioral signals. - Personalization at scale. A one-size-fits-all ad experience leaves value on the table for both customers and the business. We build systems that adapt ad load, placement, and content to individual viewers across 100M+ customers and 100k+ titles. - Small effects, large variance. Ad interventions typically produce 0.1-2% shifts in engagement, effects easily overwhelmed by natural behavioral variance. Measuring, attributing, and optimizing these small signals requires rigorous experimental design and causal methodologies. - Competing objectives. Revenue, customer engagement, long-term retention, and advertiser value are in tension. We develop principled frameworks to navigate these tradeoffs and optimize for sustainable outcomes rather than any single metric. A day in the life - Contribute to the research and development of ML models that personalize advertising decisions for 100M+ customers across 100k+ titles, with production deployment in mind - Develop deep learning architectures (multi-task learning, embedding-based representations) for customer behavior prediction at scale - Design and analyze large-scale A/B experiments, applying causal inference techniques to measure and optimize the impact of ad strategies on customer engagement and monetization - Partner with engineering to ensure models meet production latency and scalability requirements - Collaborate with product managers to frame business problems as tractable ML problems and translate findings into product decisions - Shape the team’s scientific roadmap, identifying high-impact research directions About the team Prime Video Ads is pioneering the use of Generative AI, Deep Learning and Causal ML to empower the next generation of Ads experience in Prime Video. Our vision is to build the world’s most valuable and differentiated ad-supported streaming platform: one where every ad is relevant to the viewer, and every dollar spent by an advertiser delivers measurable results. We are seeking lead applied scientists who have demonstrated experience in advancing state of the art ML algorithms, particularly in Personalization, Relevance, Casual Inference and Gen-AI areas. jobs.jd: Twitch is looking for an Applied Scientist to lead computer vision and video manipulation work within Amazon Publisher Monetization (APM). You will apply large language models (LLMs), vision-language models (VLMs), and traditional computer vision techniques to build products that directly improve how millions of Twitch creators produce content and how viewers engage with it. This is a high-visibility project backed by senior leadership, and you will have the autonomy to evaluate both first-party and third-party solutions to deliver the highest quality results quickly. If you thrive in a fast-paced, startup-like environment where your scientific decisions shape the product roadmap, we want to hear from you. Key job responsibilities Design and deploy computer vision and video manipulation models using LLMs, VLMs, and traditional techniques, taking solutions from research prototype to production. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer
jobs.jd: UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable. Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia. UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems. About the Role We’re looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to make UFORCE systems work reliably in the field. You’ll work alongside engineers, operators and customers during trials, demonstrations, training and deployments, resolving issues and turning field experience into practical improvements. Software is your primary discipline, but this is not a desk-based software role. It’s a hands-on, deployed position where you’ll work across the wider system, from networking and communications to equipment setup and operator workflows. You don’t need deep mechanical, marine or electronics expertise. We’re looking for strong software skills, practical operational experience and the ability to learn quickly. The role is a remote based role, with regular travel to field sites and customer locations locally and internationally. What You Will Do Own technical execution in the field: deploying, configuring, and supporting our systems during trials, demonstrations, training, and customer activity, often with limited backup. Manage the software side of deployments, including baselines, versions, configuration control, release notes, validation checks, and rollback and recovery procedures. Diagnose faults across the whole deployed system using structured fault isolation, separating software, hardware, network, comms, power, sensor, configuration, operator, and environmental causes. Read logs, reproduce issues, test hypotheses, and capture clear evidence, then hand issues back to Engineering with enough context to act on them quickly. Write scripts and small tools that automate checks, validate configuration, parse logs, and reduce manual work in the field. Prepare for field activity by checking equipment, cabling, compute setup, spares, tools, checklists, and documentation. Support practical tasks beyond software, such as system setup and compute swaps, and improve preparation so deployments become faster and more repeatable. Turn field observations into clear feedback for Software, Product, Operations, and Engineering, closing the gap between what is built, what is deployed, and what the customer expects. Support operators and customers during demonstrations and training, explain technical issues clearly to both specialist and non-specialist audiences, and help customers become more self-sufficient after handover. Improve software readiness over time, including observability, release discipline, documentation, and knowledge transfer, so the field depends less on engineering reach-back. What We're Looking For Strong software engineering ability as your primary discipline, with skills in Python and/or C++ for debugging, log analysis, and system maintenance. You can read, write, and debug code and scripts and are comfortable with version control, APIs, services, and logs. Systems-minded judgment. You can explain interfaces, dependencies, and trade-offs across software, compute, networking, comms, sensors, hardware, and field operations, and you avoid assuming that every problem is a software problem. Experience deploying and configuring Linux-based software systems, including package management, services, containers, updates, rollbacks, and repeatable deployment methods. Practical field troubleshooting experience in deployed or operational settings, such as military or global operations, motorsport, field engineering, remote production, customer sites, maritime, robotics, aerospace, or automotive environments. Working knowledge of networking and integration, including TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, VPNs, DNS, DHCP, firewalls, and how to tell a software failure from a connectivity, sensor, or data-link problem. Operational discipline: you prepare thoroughly, use checklists, manage risk, escalate sensibly, and stay calm under pressure. Clear technical communication, including structured, unambiguous reporting that Engineering can act on and operators can understand. A team-first, high-ownership approach. You work well with a small, multidisciplinary team, including during extended deployments, and are willing to travel regularly and support field activity. Nice to Have Experience with robotics, uncrewed systems, autonomy or mission software, sensors, telemetry, operator interfaces, or defence trials. Experience deploying software to edge compute or in disconnected environments, including containers and orchestration, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, observability, and controlled updates. Familiarity with tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Ansible, or Terraform. Experience representing a technical team in customer demonstrations, trials, training, or deployments. Experience working in security-sensitive or controlled environments. The nature of combat has changed. Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Large Enterprise
jobs.jd: About the Team OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works. Production-ready deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere. About the Role As an Applied AI Engineer you will partner directly with leading organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from use-case selection and architecture through prototyping, evaluation, production launch, and scale. You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations. This is a rare opportunity to work on consequential real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI’s products evolve. This role is based in Munich/Berlin. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees In this role, you will: - Partner directly with enterprise and digital native customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and measurable success criteria. - Design, build, and deploy AI systems that solve important customer problems and produce measurable business outcomes. - Work hands-on in code to build prototypes, evaluation harnesses, reference implementations, integrations, and production accelerators. - Make sound technical decisions across models, agents, retrieval, tools, data, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and governance. - Diagnose complex implementation challenges, reproduce failures, test hypotheses, and drive blockers toward resolution. - Help customers progress from promising prototypes to reliable production systems, sustained adoption, and scaled impact. - Partner closely with customer engineering teams and OpenAI Product, Research, Engineering, Security, and go-to-market teams, translating deployment experience into high-signal product feedback. - Create reusable architectures, tooling, playbooks, and technical guidance that accelerate future enterprise deployments. You’ll thrive in this role if you: - Have a demonstrated track record of 5+ years of designing, building, and delivering AI or machine-learning systems in enterprise environments, including taking systems from prototype to production. Relevant backgrounds may include applied AI or ML engineering, forward-deployed engineering, software engineering, customer engineering, solutions architecture, product engineering or technical consulting. - Are fluent in both German and English - Can point to substantial personal contributions in code, architecture, evaluation, debugging, or engineering of production systems—not only program or stakeholder management. - Are highly proficient in Python and comfortable working across an AI application stack; experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another relevant language is valuable. - Understand how to evaluate AI systems systematically using representative data, graders, production signals, and human judgment. - Have navigated enterprise production requirements such as integrations, reliability, observability, security, privacy, data governance, performance, and cost. - Can connect technical decisions to customer workflows, adoption, and measurable business outcomes. - Communicate with clarity and credibility across hands-on engineers, technical leaders, security teams, product leaders, and executives. - Bring high agency, strong technical judgment, and end-to-end ownership in ambiguous environments. - Learn quickly, challenge assumptions constructively, and collaborate with humility; experience in a particular industry or with OpenAI products is not required. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. jobs.jd: The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. jobs.title: Software Engineer, AWS Applied AI Solutions
jobs.jd: AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset. We're building Chorus, a real-time document workspace where AI agents are actual collaborators: an agent gets a cursor in the doc, edits the same CRDT, and shows up in presence right next to you. We wrote it from scratch in Rust and TypeScript; we sync in under 50ms with hundreds of simultaneous editors on a single document, and it costs roughly a dollar per builder per year to run. It's an exciting combination of greenfield work with a massive user base that provides immediate feedback when something doesn't work. Requirements • You proactively seek out problems, propose solutions, and own delivery • You find ways to deliver code with agents at high speed without sacrificing the quality of the code or the software. • Experience in building distributed and high-concurrency systems We're a small team with an unusually direct line from idea to thousands of builders using it. If you want to be one of maybe a dozen people in the world shipping production CRDT infrastructure that treats AI as a peer, this is the job. Key job responsibilities • Own the design and delivery of significant components of a service scaling from early customers to broad AWS adoption • Contribute to technical discussions with partner teams — bring data, document tradeoffs, and help the team land on a decision • Recognize when a one-off solution is the right call versus when a pattern is emerging that deserves a real abstraction, and raise it with the team • Raise the bar through thorough code reviews and by helping onboard newer engineers to the codebase and team practices • Contribute to operational excellence: add monitoring and alarming for the features you build, follow through on production readiness, and take ownership during on-call A day in the life Your mornings are usually free for focus work -- architecture deep dives and hard problems. Around 11 you'll have standup, then grab lunch with the team (if you like) before the afternoon opens up for design reviews, CR feedback, or unblocking an engineer. Some days you're deep in code; others you're on a call with a customer team working through how their system integrates with yours. You're the person who knows the system most deeply -- and you work to ensure you're never the bottleneck. The problems are hard and the stakes are high -- but we believe we can move fast, do exceptional work, and have a full life outside of it. About the team Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud. Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience - 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience - 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience - 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience - Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field - Experience programming with at least one software programming language - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, TTS
jobs.jd: About Cantina Cantina is a new social platform founded by Sean Parker with the most advanced AI character creator. Our bots are lifelike, social creatures that can interact wherever people are online—across voice, video, and text. Create yourself, imagine someone new, or choose from thousands of characters to share infinitely scalable, personalized content and seamless group chat. If you’re excited about how AI can shape creativity and social interaction, come help us build what’s next. About the Role: We’re looking for a Research / ML Engineer to join our Speech Team to build state-of-the-art speech systems end-to-end—from data specs through production inference. You’ll drive the model ↔ data ↔ eval flywheel for TTS and adjacent tasks (voice cloning, controllable TTS, voice conversion and more), partnering closely with research, data, and infra to ship fast, reliable, and cost-aware models. In this role, you will work at the intersection of cutting-edge research and practical engineering, contributing to the development of safe, steerable, and trustworthy AI systems. What You’ll Do: Model Building: Architect, implement, pre-train, fine-tune, and post-train/alignment (e.g., GRPO/DPO) for large-scale speech models. Project Leadership: Independently lead small research projects while collaborating on larger team initiatives. Experimental Design: Design, run, and analyze scientific experiments to advance our understanding of the models. Tool Development: Develop and improve dev tooling to enhance team productivity. Full-Stack Contribution: Contribute to the entire stack, from low-level optimizations to high-level model design. Data Ownership: Define data requirements and collaborate on acquisition, curation, augmentation, labeling quality, and synthetic data strategies. Rigorous Evaluation: Design automated objective/subjective evaluations—listening tests, SV/WER/ASR-based metrics, robustness & bias checks, and red-team studies. Pipeline Delivery: Harden the training → evaluation → inference pipeline; profile latency, memory, and cost; and meet production SLAs with robust monitoring and rollback. GPU Scaling: Partner with infrastructure to run distributed training/inference on cloud fleets and productionize models with reliability and observability. Safety & Responsibility: Contribute to safety/consent guardrails and to misuse/abuse mitigation for responsible speech technology. What You’ll Bring: Exceptional research/development experience with large scale audio models (>3B models and >500k hours data). Exceptional understanding and hands-on experience with transformer architectures and/or diffusion models (inc. distillation and streaming) and/or audio language modelling. Strong experience with multi-node and multi-gpu distributed model training. Strong software engineering skills with a proven track record of building complex systems Strong with PyTorch and performance work (profiling, CUDA/Triton/C++ as needed) and writing reliable production quality code. Shipped large scale speech/audio models to production. Background in working with large-scale ML data. Ability to iterate on data,, and triangulate quality using subjective and objective signals. Notable publications and/or open source contributions in speech/audio/ML. Experience with voice-cloning, speech-control, voice-generation. Preferred Experience: Shipped large scale speech/audio models (TTS/VC/ASR) to production. Work on large-scale ML systems. Experience with audio language modelling, transformer architectures. Experience with voice-cloning, speech-control, voice-generation. Background in processing large-scale ML data. Publications or notable open-source in speech/audio/ML. Compensation: When determining compensation, a number of factors will be considered, including skills, experience, job scope, location, and competitive compensation market data. Benefits for U.S.-based roles: Competitive salary and generous company equity Medical, dental, and vision insurance – 99.99% of premiums covered by Cantina 42 days of paid time off, including: 15 PTO days 10 sick days 15 company holidays 2 floating holidays Generous parental leave & fertility support 401(k) retirement savings plan Lifestyle spending account – $500/month to use however you’d like Complimentary lunch and snacks for in-office employees One Medical membership, and more!

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - Flow
jobs.jd: About Flow by ServiceNow Flow is a product and a new business unit in ServiceNow staffed by a team of 0-1 builders. We’re creating Flow, an AI-native conversational experience for natural language automation and enterprise service management. Flow is built on a new tech stack with new ways of working. We challenge established practices and are defining a new product and GTM playbook for ServiceNow. Flow puts what we build in front of the largest possible audience. You’ll have real ownership of the work, the freedom to move fast, and the resources of a global technology leader behind you. If you have a point of view on building and want to start from the beginning again, we want to talk to you, wherever you are. Plenty of people can ship an AI prototype this year. Few get to build a product that runs enterprise work at global scale. Join us. Job Description We are hiring a hands-on Senior Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer who serves as the technical champion for customers, guiding them from their first demo and trial to long-term success with Flow. You will demonstrate the product, answer technical questions, set up and enable Flow, and help customers build automations and integrations through AI-assisted, natural-language development. You will solve problems the product does not yet handle and translate customer needs into clear requirements that help product managers prioritize what to build next. The role combines technical implementation, customer success, and support. Ready to be the person who turns “we’re stuck” into “we’re live”? We’re looking for a hybrid problem-solver who helps trial customers and enterprise IT teams unlock the full power of Flow. You will own complex customer problems end to end, and your work will shape what Flow does next. What You Will Do Technical Solutions Work with customer IT and security teams to configure SSO and integrations with tools such as Okta, Microsoft Teams, Slack, and ServiceNow. Build, test, and launch automations with Flow’s natural-language builder, connecting to tools such as Jira, Workday, Zoom, Microsoft 365, and ServiceNow. Connect document sources such as SharePoint, Google Drive, Box, Notion, and the ServiceNow knowledge base so the AI returns accurate, sourced answers. Solve complex customer requirements outside the standard product, document effective workarounds, and turn customer learnings into clear product requirements that you help refine and shepherd through delivery. Build proof-of-concept solutions and workflows for strategic evaluations. Customer Success and Adoption Guide new customers through a structured onboarding path, setting up and enabling Flow in a few hours so they can reach a live production deployment in one day. Monitor usage, conversation allowances, and automation results in Flow analytics, using the data to demonstrate value and identify new automation opportunities. Identify opportunities to expand Flow from an initial use case into a broader self-service service desk. Translate customer pain points and requests into clear product requirements, then partner with product and engineering to refine and shepherd them through delivery. Support and Reliability Own first-line triage for trial and enterprise customers, answering technical questions and escalating issues when deeper product or engineering support is needed. Be the go-to person when customers encounter API timeouts, sync errors, payment-related questions, or failed automations, and drive issues from initial diagnosis through resolution. Reproduce bugs, isolate root causes, and work directly with core engineers to resolve them. Monitor health, audit, and activity logs to identify outages or issues that prevent customers from using Flow fully. Use Flow audit and activity logs to diagnose complex customer issues, confirm what happened, and drive the issue to resolution. 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role, such as forward deployed, solutions, or implementation engineering, in enterprise software. Hands-on experience with REST APIs, scripting, automations, and webhooks, with comfort testing them using tools such as Postman or cURL. Working knowledge of single sign-on and identity providers, including SAML, OAuth, Okta, and Entra ID. Experience with enterprise service management or collaboration tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, Slack, or Microsoft Teams. Familiarity with AI and workflow automation, including prompt design and how AI systems retrieve information from documents. Communicate clearly with stakeholders from IT directors to system administrators and security engineers. See how Flow fits into a customer’s broader IT and operations strategy and ServiceNow’s plans. Demonstrated ability to take ownership of customer outcomes while partnering effectively across product, engineering, support, and customer teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience with service desk offerings. Experience with AI-native or cloud-native enterprise products. Background in product-led growth or consumption-priced software. Experience building an onboarding or implementation motion from scratch; startup experience is helpful but not required. jobs.title: Mechanical Forward Deployed Engineer - Switzerland
jobs.jd:
About CoLab

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster.

Proudly based in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018. Since then we’ve raised a $72M Series C, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (Fast 500™), signed multi-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier, and grown to a team of 250+.

About the Role

This is a high-impact role that helps define how CoLab delivers technical value to its most strategic customers in Aerospace and Defence. CoLab is a category-creating product, which means adoption isn't just a rollout. It's a change in how the organization works.

In this role, you'd act as a trusted advisor, leveraging people, process, and technology to help teams rethink how they manage feedback, data, and decision-making across design and PLM. That means getting deep into customer workflows, testing new ways of working, and building repeatable methods the rest of the team can scale.

You'll work alongside a Customer Success Manager, and use what you learn on the front line to help shape product direction. This role isn't about selling or pitching. It's about deeply understanding engineering problems and solving them alongside the customer.

We are looking for a candidate in Switzerland to work regularly on-site with local CoLab customers.

Our Ideal Candidate

You’re a mechanical engineer by trade and have worked as a designer in an A&D company. You also understand the full product development life cycle: how design, manufacturing, quality, and engineering leadership depend on each other, and where collaboration breaks down. You can coach those teams toward working together better.

You know how to improve that life cycle with technology. Maybe you’ve championed internal tools or created automation or scripts.

You also know a process that makes sense on paper won’t get adopted on its own. You can meet people where they are, including the stakeholders who don’t want to change.

You don’t need to be the loudest voice in the room, but you can run a sprint and lead a cross-functional project. If the average person might find this job too undefined or complex, that probably excites you.

Job Responsibilities

  • Mapping a customer's current-state design review and engineering workflows, and defining the target-state process their teams will actually adopt.
  • Deploying and tuning CoLab's AI capabilities against a customer's own standards, drawing checklists, and design guidelines, and diagnosing what's working and what isn't.
  • Providing mechanical engineering expertise to validate AI-generated results and ensure engineering rigor.
  • Investigating and solving complex engineering data and integration challenges across PLM, ERP, QMS, and traditional design feedback tools.
  • Expanding adoption into new teams, programs, and sites within the account, partnering with the Customer Success Manager on where the next opportunity sits.
  • Collaborating with product teams to identify feature gaps, improve capabilities, and refine AutoReview.

Qualifications

Must-haves:

  • Background in mechanical design engineering, ideally in a medium- to large-sized organization.
  • Strong understanding of PLM & ERP systems and enterprise engineering data architecture.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects and cross-functional collaborations.
  • Experience working directly with customers or internal stakeholders to solve technical problems.
  • Comfort working in fast-changing, ambiguous environments.
  • Strong written communication and documentation skills.
  • Working knowledge of high-level AI architecture, specifically LLMs.
  • Familiarity with APIs, data integrations, and enterprise architecture concepts.
  • Located in Switzerland 

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with internal tool development, scripting, or automation.
  • Exposure to AI/ML tools applied to engineering workflows.
  • Prior work in design consulting or product development at scale.

Travel Expectations

While this is a fully remote role, travel is a consistent part of the job. There are two primary types of travel you can expect:

  • Team Weeks: Once per quarter, the sales team or entire company gets together in person. These typically involve traveling out on a Monday and returning on a Thursday or Friday. Two of these each year are held at our headquarters in St. John's, Newfoundland, Canada and the others take place in more central locations that evolve as the team grows.
